# The Phoenix Recovery Center

> > The Phoenix Recovery Center is a comprehensive addiction and mental health treatment facility in Utah offering a full continuum of care from residential inpatient programs to outpatient services.

Located in South Jordan, Utah, The Phoenix Recovery Center provides evidence-based treatment for substance abuse and mental health disorders through multiple program levels including residential treatment, PHP day programs, intensive outpatient (IOP), and general outpatient (GOP) services. Founded by Jake Shoff, the center combines psychiatric care, detoxification, and therapeutic support across its continuum of care.

## Key Topics

- Residential Treatment
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- General Outpatient Program (GOP)
- Addiction Recovery
- Mental Health Treatment
- Continuum of Care
- Inpatient Drug Rehab
- Psychiatric Care
- Detoxification Services
- Group Therapy
- Individual Therapy
- Clinical Assessment
- Insurance Verification
- South Jordan, Utah

## Addiction Recovery Programs

- [Addiction Recovery Services](https://thephoenixrc.com/addiction-recovery-services): Comprehensive addiction recovery services including residential and outpatient programs.
- [Inpatient Drug Rehab Treatment Center](https://thephoenixrc.com/addiction-recovery-services/residential-treatment): Inpatient residential drug rehab with psychiatric care and detox services.
- [Day Treatment Program & Addiction Counseling](https://thephoenixrc.com/addiction-recovery-services/php-day-treatment): Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) day treatment for addiction recovery.
- [Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)](https://thephoenixrc.com/addiction-recovery-services/iop-intensive-outpatient-program): Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) for addiction treatment and recovery.
- [General Outpatient Program For Drug & Alcohol Abuse](https://thephoenixrc.com/addiction-recovery-services/gop-general-outpatient-program): General Outpatient Program (GOP) step-down care for substance abuse recovery.

## Mental Health Services

- [Utah Inpatient Mental Health Facility](https://thephoenixrc.com/mental-health-services): Inpatient mental health facility with residential and outpatient programs.
- [Mental Health Residential Treatment](https://thephoenixrc.com/mental-health-services/mental-health-residential-treatment): Residential mental health treatment with psychiatric stabilization and assessment.
- [Mental Health PHP Day Program](https://thephoenixrc.com/mental-health-services/php-day-treatment): Partial Hospitalization Program for mental health stabilization and recovery.
- [Mental Health Intensive Outpatient Programs](https://thephoenixrc.com/mental-health-services/iop-intensive-outpatient-program): IOP for mental health treatment with group and individual therapy services.
- [Mental Health General Outpatient Program](https://thephoenixrc.com/mental-health-services/gop-general-outpatient-program): General Outpatient Program for mental health with individual and group therapy.
